description: This file implements the NodePairingApprovalPrompter class which manages node pairing approval dialogs, reconciling pairing requests, handling user responses, automation (silent approvals), and notifications within a macOS application. It interacts with external services such as GatewayConnection, NotificationCenter, and various support modules to facilitate secure node pairing.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing node pairing approval dialogs, reconciling requests, auto-approving silent requests, and notifying users.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: A Codable structure representing the list of pending and paired nodes.

classes.name: PairedNode
classes.description: A Codable structure representing a paired node with its details.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: A Codable structure representing a pending node pairing request.

classes.name: SSHTarget
classes.description: A simple struct representing SSH connection target details.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the prompter, clearing previous tasks and starting push notifications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing tasks, clears state, and cancels pending reconciliation.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of pending pairing requests from the gateway, with retries.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Continuously reconciles pairing requests periodically to keep in sync with external changes.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a new pairing list, updates internal state, detects resolved requests, and manages dialogs.

methods.name: inferResolution
methods.description: Determines the resolution (approved/rejected) of a pairing request based on current data.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pending request alert if conditions permit.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog for a specific pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user response to the pairing alert, including approve/reject actions.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a pairing request and logs the operation.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection for a pairing request and logs the operation.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a user notification about pairing approval or rejection.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to silently approve a request if eligible, using SSH or other criteria.
